tools.name: onyx_decide
tools.description: Return allow / review / deny for a counterparty address against your own risk policy, with the reasons named. Use this before every outbound transfer. Checks issuer blacklists (USDT, USDC), sanctions across six EVM chains plus the OFAC list, open scam databases, community reports and behavioural pat

tools.name: onyx_screen
tools.description: Return the raw risk markers for one address: risk zone, issuer blacklists, sanctions coverage, scam databases, community reports, address age, balance and exchange attribution where known. Use this when you want the facts rather than a decision. Costs credit.

tools.name: onyx_screen_batch
tools.description: Screen up to 50 addresses in a single call, for example before a mass payout. Priced per address, and only addresses actually screened are charged. Each result carries facts_complete so you can tell whether the behavioural facts finished loading.

tools.name: onyx_preflight
tools.description: Operational safety check for a payment, separate from risk screening. Detects address poisoning (a lookalike planted in your history so it gets copied instead of the real address), contract recipients that would swallow the tokens, and addresses that behave differently on different chains. Pass know

tools.name: onyx_trace
tools.description: Multi-hop trace of outgoing flows from an address, with attribution where a node is known (exchange labels, deposit addresses). Use it to establish provenance after receiving funds. Costs more than a screening call.

tools.name: onyx_watch
tools.description: Subscribe to an address. When it enters an issuer blacklist, a sanctions list or a scam database, we POST a signed event to your callback URL. A one-off check cannot warn you about a freeze that has not happened yet. Billed per address per day. The callback must be public https.

tools.name: onyx_balance
tools.description: How much credit your API key has left, and the current prices. Free.

tools.name: onyx_payment_info
tools.description: Machine-readable payment terms: which asset and network to send, the address, prices per operation, and how to claim an API key from the address you paid from. No account or signup is involved. Free, and works without a key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: onyx_decide, onyx_watch · Private data: onyx_preflight, onyx_watch, onyx_balance, onyx_payment_info · Public sink: onyx_watch, onyx_payment_info · Destructive: onyx_preflight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: onyx_decide, onyx_watch · Private data: onyx_preflight, onyx_watch, onyx_balance, onyx_payment_info · Public sink: onyx_watch, onyx_payment_info · Destructive: onyx_preflight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
